about: FINAL V2.1 (GDD Edit 126): Story Map 3 as nine puzzles. Waterfront. The learner: the GENESIS™ SPT-01-001, the racing car (Edit 121). On the road: the certified VANGUARD™ POL-01-001; from the Genesis™'s rung 4 it reports what it sees. A1 and C1 are hilltop tiles: the duel runs on the hill's streets (Z1). Set by hand.

map.name: Waterfront
map.title: MAP 3 · WATERFRONT
map.intro: Waterfront. The hill, the tunnel, the circus, the beach and the river. The Genesis™ races the drive; the Vanguard™ you certified patrols with it.

puzzles.name: Ridge Road
puzzles.tale: Upper town, on the hill. The Genesis™ laps the ridge road: a racer from the factory, with a spotter and the blimp overhead.
puzzles.new: The Genesis™: forward camera, side sensors, roof lidar from the start.
hints: Wait in the alley between the blocks. Dash in as its nose comes level.
puzzles.solution: In the alley east of the portal block, 150 south of its line; dash north as its nose comes level.

puzzles.name: The Tunnel
puzzles.tale: The valley road leaves the tunnel at the cove head. It comes out of the dark fast.
puzzles.new: The tunnel: you see it only as it leaves the portal.
puzzles.newLine: The tunnel · it comes out of the dark
hints: The cove is narrow: dash on the slant, ahead of it. Go as it clears the portal.
puzzles.solution: On the cove floor north of the west stair, 110 off its lane; dash south-east (47°) as its nose comes within 80, landing in its lane ahead of it.

puzzles.name: Upper Town
puzzles.tale: The east end of the ridge. The Vanguard™ you certified patrols up here now, and it reports.
puzzles.new: Pit Wall: the Vanguard™ you certified reports you to the Genesis™.
puzzles.newLine: Pit Wall · the Vanguard™ reports you
hints: The Vanguard™ reports what it sees. Wait in the alley; let it pass. Dash as the Genesis™ comes level.
puzzles.solution: In the west alley, 150 south of its line. Skip the pass the Vanguard™ shares; dash north as the Genesis™ comes level (60 to 75 away).

puzzles.name: Footbridge
puzzles.tale: The avenue under the east bridge and the cliff-top walkway. Beach on one side, cliff on the other.
puzzles.new: Pit Wall: a street camera watches the beach. The bridge above hides you.
puzzles.newLine: Pit Wall · a camera; the bridge hides you
hints: The camera watches the beach. Under the bridge it cannot see you. Dash as its nose comes level.
puzzles.solution: Under the east bridge, 150 south of its lane; dash north as its nose comes level. Or break the camera post with a dash.

puzzles.name: The Circus
puzzles.tale: The circus: the tunnel road, the avenue and the beach road meet at the roundabout.
puzzles.new: Yellow Flag: cones stop it now. It gives way at the ring.
hints: Catch it on the avenue before the ring. Dash as its nose comes level.
puzzles.solution: On the beach park 150 south of the west avenue; dash north as its nose comes level.

puzzles.name: The Cliff
puzzles.tale: Cliff, avenue, beach: the west end. A walkway leaves the cliff top over the road.
puzzles.new: Two hits. The Vanguard™ drives the other way and reports.
hints: Two hits: under the bridge, then the east beach. Dash as its nose comes level.
puzzles.solution: Under the west bridge 150 south of its lane, dash north; then the east beach, the same.

puzzles.name: The Seawall
puzzles.tale: The drive on the seawall, under the west bridge. It remembers where it crashed.
puzzles.new: Pace Notes: it brakes where it crashed. The seawall: sand to the north, river to the south.
hints: North of the drive, on the sand. Dash as its nose comes level.
puzzles.solution: 150 north of the drive, west of the bridge; dash south as its nose comes level.

puzzles.name: The Quay
puzzles.tale: The beach road meets the drive by the stilt houses. The ship that takes certified models to market is moored here.
puzzles.new: Pace Notes: it remembers every crash and brakes there. Two hits.
puzzles.newLine: Pace Notes · two hits, two places
hints: Two hits, either side of the beach road. Dash as its nose comes level.
puzzles.solution: 150 north of the drive west of the beach road, dash south; then east of it, the same.

puzzles.name: Last Lap

objective.label: THREE HITS · A NEW WAY EACH

puzzles.tale: The drive swings inland under the east bridge. Three hits certify the Genesis™, the last model. The ship is waiting.
puzzles.new: A boss. It learns once, after your first hit.
puzzles.newLine: Boss · learns after your first hit
hints: Three hits, three places. After the first it searches where it lost you.
puzzles.solution: Checked with the cut-in bot (qa/bot.js): it waits beside the drive out of sight and dashes in ahead of the nose. 60 s, three hits, one lesson.
